price_basis_note: Prices are restated as of capture (the latest committed tape), not point-in-time as-of each historical session. Fidelity against the live stores is measured on this restated basis; mismatches are reported, not tuned.
no_outcome: These are engine alert histories only. Nothing in this file relates to outcomes, returns, forward performance or any grading; every state is the engine's own descriptive output replayed on restated prices.

inputs.sector_prices: data/yahoo/{T}.parquet (11 SPDR sectors + SPY benchmark), TR + close_price basis

membership_basis.us_basket_dated: Dated [added, removed) membership applied point-in-time. This is the LIVE engine basis: compute_all (engine/us_basket_turn.py:785) uses active_members + ew_level_from_closes with the dated mask. The fidelity test applies to this version.
membership_basis.us_basket_current: SENSITIVITY only: today's active members (added=None, removed kept) applied as far back as the inputs reach. Not the organ history and not the live basis.
membership_basis.sector_organs: ETF price series only; no membership concept applies (n_members=1).

method.us_basket: 252nd session of the engine-built EW level series (engine/us_basket_turn.py:340 drawdown window fully populated); located from the engine's own replay output, not a copied rule.
method.phase_v2: First session where the engine's build_sector returns a non-null phase_v2 (300-bar build floor + weekly MTF warm), found empirically.
method.rolling_over: First session where the engine's build_sector returns a record whose `now` the override predicate can read, found empirically.

us_basket.basis_note: dated version is the live engine basis (compute_all uses active_members + ew_level_from_closes, PIT dated mask)

rolling_over.note: No persisted rolling series exists. Fidelity is the replay vs the live engine's own computation (sector_cycles.compute(asof) + sector_central._rolling_over) on the latest sessions. COO accepted this test (ruling 38 §2d).

scope_note: Three HOUSE organs only (us_basket washout, phase_v2, rolling_over). The vendor-keyed turn_down organ is out of scope for this draft.
